Import.PasteTooltip: Paste a monster stat block from the world's oldest roleplaying game (5th edition), 2014 or 2024 layout. Parsing is deterministic and happens entirely on your machine; the AI button is a fallback for pastes the parser cannot read.
Import.PastePlaceholder: Paste the full stat block here, from the name line down to the last action…
Import.AiParseHint: Sends the pasted text to OpenAI for transcription into the same structure the parser produces. The conversion maths afterwards is identical - the model cannot set a single stat.
Import.NothingParsed: Nothing to parse - paste a stat block first.
Import.MissingField: Could not find: {field}. Fill the gap by hand after creating, or try Parse with AI.
Import.TuneTooltip: Each stat was classified against what a creature of that CR is expected to have, and the value comes from the Building Creatures table for the target level. Change a tier to overrule the classification; the marked option is the classifier's suggestion.
Import.EmptyPreview: Parse a stat block to see the converted creature here.
Import.RewriteHint: Optional: sends ability prose to OpenAI to be rephrased in PF2e idiom. DCs and saves are recomputed from the tables afterwards, so the model cannot drift a number.

Builder.BasicsTooltip: Name, level and road map. The road map is the book's guidance for a creature concept: picking one re-seeds every tier below, and you can then adjust any of them.
Builder.Name: Name
Builder.NameRequired: Give the creature a name first.
Builder.RoadMapHint: Building Creatures road maps: a starting array of tiers for a concept. Picking one resets the stat tiers.
Builder.DescriptionPlaceholder: What is this creature? Appearance, behaviour, lore…
Builder.DescriptionHint: Stored in the actor's notes and used as the artwork prompt.
Builder.StatsTooltip: Every value is read from the Building Creatures tables for the chosen level: pick the tier, the number follows. Extreme is exceptional, high is a strength, moderate is typical, low/terrible are weaknesses.
Builder.AbilitiesTooltip: Ability modifier tiers from the same tables. Mostly descriptive on an NPC sheet, but keep them consistent with the concept: a brute has high Strength.
Builder.StrikesTooltip: Each strike uses the attack and damage tiers chosen above. Ranged strikes get a 30 ft. range increment you can edit on the sheet afterwards.
Builder.SkillsTooltip: Skills with their tier; the modifier comes from the skills table for the level.
Builder.GearHint: Listed on the sheet only; the statistics above already account for gear.

Create.ArtHint: Uses your OpenAI key to paint a portrait from the creature's description and set it as both the actor image and the prototype token.
Create.SpellsMissing: {count} spell(s) had no match in the compendium and were listed on the sheet instead: {list}
Create.UnmatchedSpellsBody: These printed spells have no direct match in the spells compendium. Pick replacements by hand or drop them:
Create.ArtFailed: The actor was created, but artwork generation failed: {message}
Create.GearMissing: No compendium match for this gear, so it was left off the inventory: {list}

Preview.SpellLine: DC {dc}, attack {attack} (add spells on the sheet)

Generate.UsingModelHint: Requests go straight from this browser to the API using your key.

ApiKey.Name: OpenAI API key
ApiKey.Hint: Stored only in this browser (client scope), never in the world database, so players can never see it. Each GM enters their own.

Model.Name: Text model
Model.Hint: Model used for AI parsing and ability rewrites.

ModelOverride.Name: Model override
ModelOverride.Hint: Free-text model id; wins over the dropdown when set.

BaseUrl.Name: API base URL
BaseUrl.Hint: Change to point at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

Temperature.Name: Temperature
Temperature.Hint: Blank omits the parameter (required for reasoning models). 0-2 otherwise.

Timeout.Name: Request timeout (seconds)
Timeout.Hint: How long to wait before abandoning a request.

ImageModel.Name: Image model
ImageModel.Hint: Model used for portrait and token artwork.

ImageQuality.Name: Image quality
ImageQuality.Hint: Higher quality costs more per image.

OutputLanguage.Name: Output language
OutputLanguage.Hint: Language for AI-generated prose (e.g. "Spanish"). Blank follows Foundry's language.

Usage.TokensOnly: OpenAI: {input} in / {output} out tokens (no price known for this model).

Errors.NoApiKey: No OpenAI API key is configured in the module settings.
Errors.ActorCreateFailed: Foundry refused to create the actor - check the console for validation errors.
